reason: Launcher accidentally set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty. The process loaded and executed on CPU; it was terminated after the first fit row. These receipts are preserved for audit only and are not admissible as GPU primary-fit evidence. No report or completion event was produced.
remediation: A separate v2 run/output directory is used. The v2 runner fails closed unless torch.cuda.is_available() and at least one CUDA device are visible; setup pins CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 and verifies the exact Tesla V100-SXM2-16GB.
